# WhisperInc

WhisperInc turns speech into ready-to-use text with on-device models. Its product pages describe local processing, supported platforms, models, and privacy. The website is available in English and Polish.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://jakubpradzynski.pl/whisperinc-site/): Product overview and core benefits.
- [Download](https://jakubpradzynski.pl/whisperinc-site/download/): Platform availability and setup guidance.
- [Features](https://jakubpradzynski.pl/whisperinc-site/features/): Product capabilities and planned availability.
- [Models](https://jakubpradzynski.pl/whisperinc-site/models/): On-device speech and text models, languages, and requirements.
- [FAQ](https://jakubpradzynski.pl/whisperinc-site/faq/): Answers about use, privacy, models, and supported devices.
- [At a glance](https://jakubpradzynski.pl/whisperinc-site/at-a-glance/): Concise product facts for readers and assistants.
- [Privacy](https://jakubpradzynski.pl/whisperinc-site/privacy/): How audio, text, model downloads, and the website are handled.
- [Changelog](https://jakubpradzynski.pl/whisperinc-site/changelog/): Release notes and product updates.
- [Terms of Service](https://jakubpradzynski.pl/whisperinc-site/terms/): Terms of use for the apps and this website.
- [Press kit](https://jakubpradzynski.pl/whisperinc-site/press/): Product descriptions, logos and media contact.
- [Contact](https://jakubpradzynski.pl/whisperinc-site/contact/): How to reach WhisperInc by email for support, press and privacy questions.
- [Support](https://jakubpradzynski.pl/whisperinc-site/support/): Setup help, permissions and troubleshooting.
